Le Mars Agri-Center is Your Full-Service Ag Solution
Our priority is you and your needs as a farmer. We know planning is key in business, especially in agriculture. With your success in mind, we offer a full-service line of ag products. Grain is our specialty- we have years of experience purchasing and helping you merchandise your grain.
We are committed to our relationships and our communities. Due to that, precise goals make us tick and challenge us to come up with solutions to make your farming operation more profitable. Call or stop in today and we can plan your farming success!
